name: Aternos
limits: Server stops when empty and may queue at peak times. RAM is shared and varies by software/version (about 2.4GB for Vanilla 1.20.1); storage is capped at 4GB.
notes: Free forever and ad-funded. Supports Java/Bedrock, plugins, mods, modpacks and Google Drive backups; no FTP or custom JAR uploads.

name: Minehut
limits: 1GB RAM, 10 player slots and 10GB storage. Free servers sleep when empty; only the paid Ultimate plan stays online 24/7.
notes: No credit card. Java and Bedrock crossplay on one address; plugins install from the web dashboard.

name: FalixNodes
limits: 3GB shared RAM, 1 CPU core, 10GB NVMe and unlimited slots. Stops 10 minutes after the last player leaves; activity check every 3 hours; brief queues when busy.
notes: No card; one server per account. Supports plugins, mods, modpacks, Java/Bedrock and Google Drive backups.

name: FreeMcServer.net
limits: 1.7GB RAM standard, up to 4GB with ads; 10GB NVMe and unlimited slots. Renew every 4 hours (6 with an ad); the server stops 30 minutes after renewal if nobody joins and is deleted after 30 days without renewal.
notes: No card. Full FTP and custom JAR after account verification; extra servers with verification or a Discord boost.

name: Minefort
limits: 1GB RAM and up to 3 free servers. Must be woken manually from the dashboard; locked after 3 days idle and unlocked through staff.
notes: No card. Plugin manager, file manager, FTP and a Bedrock toggle are included.

name: PowerupStack
limits: 3GB total RAM, 2 CPU threads, 4GB SSD and about 10 players recommended. Stops 5 minutes after empty and auto-starts when a player joins; verified accounts keep data about 2 months.
notes: No card. Java/Bedrock support, approved plugins only, no hard player-slot cap.

name: SwiftServers
limits: 2GB RAM, 1.25 CPU cores and 10GB NVMe. Sleeps 5 minutes after empty and wakes when a player joins; hibernated after 7 days offline and deleted after 30 days.
notes: No card and no ads. Java/Bedrock crossplay, plugins/modpacks, backups and a public server hub.

name: FreeGameHost
limits: 4GB RAM, 200% CPU, 6GB NVMe and unlimited slots. Free servers hibernate when empty and use an 8-hour renewal that stacks up to 24 hours; renew daily to keep them online. Resources are self-reported and ad-funded.
notes: No card. Pterodactyl panel, full SFTP, mods/modpacks and daily backups. Newer, less established provider; availability is not guaranteed.

name: Tick Hosting
limits: Free tiers offer 4GB, 6GB or 8GB RAM with 10GB NVMe and unlimited slots. Renew every 8, 6 or 4 hours; the server stays online between renewals but stops if one is missed.
notes: No card. SFTP, modpacks and five regions. 24/7 while renewals are maintained.

name: AxentHost
limits: Choose 2–16GB RAM using free credits (5 credits per GB per hour), up to 20GB NVMe, no slot cap. No idle sleep; the server stops only when the credit balance reaches zero.
notes: No card. Free credits are claimed hourly; Java/Bedrock crossplay, mods/plugins and backups are included.

name: Severoo
limits: Up to 6GB RAM and 15GB NVMe with no player cap. Stays online while renewed with free credits; renewal is every few hours. Suspended if missed and deleted after 7 days.
notes: No card; credits cannot be bought. Supports plugins, mods and Java/Bedrock crossplay.

name: CoalByte
limits: 3GB dedicated RAM, 1 vCPU and 8GB NVMe. Claims 24/7 operation with no idle shutdown; no player cap is stated.
notes: No card. Newer provider with Java/Bedrock crossplay, SFTP and backups. Verify availability before committing a world.

name: HidenCloud
limits: 3GB RAM, 2 vCores, 15GB storage and 10–15 recommended players. Renew weekly; suspended after 7 days and deleted 5 days later. Ads appear in the panel.
notes: No card; one free service per user. Java/Bedrock/PocketMine, SFTP, backups and DDoS protection. Free slots are often full.

name: OuiHeberg
limits: 8GB RAM, 2 vCores, 2GB SSD and a hard limit of 4 simultaneous players. Monthly activity confirmation is required; mods and modpacks are not allowed.
notes: No card. Servers stay online when empty; plugins are supported and Bedrock joins through Geyser. Best for very small groups.

name: Oracle Cloud Always Free (Self-Setup)
limits: 12GB RAM, 2 ARM cores and 200GB block storage. ARM capacity varies by region; idle instances may be reclaimed after 7 days below 20% usage, and accounts may be suspended after 30 days idle.
notes: Self-hosted: you install Java, open ports and manage backups. Always Free and includes two 1GB AMD micro VMs.

name: Play Hosting
limits: 3GB RAM, 10GB NVMe and no slot cap. Free servers go through a creation/start queue and are not guaranteed 24/7; the terms describe best-effort availability rather than an uptime SLA.
notes: Free forever, no card. Ryzen 9 7950X/9950X, modpack installer, Bedrock crossplay, extra ports and subusers. Built by Tubbo/Timbers Studio.

name: MineStrator MyBoxFree
limits: 4GB RAM, 1 dedicated core plus 1 FlexCore and 8GB NVMe. Free servers stop after 4 hours offline and must be renewed monthly; no card is required.
notes: Mods/plugins, SFTP, backups and DDoS protection. Good for small private worlds, not for 24/7 public servers.

name: Eternal Zero
limits: 6GB RAM, 3 cores/300% and 20GB NVMe (25GB on request). Renew every 7h for 6GB, 9h for 4GB or 13h for 2GB; a 2h cooldown and country restrictions apply. A missed renewal stops the server.
notes: No queue and no card. 24/7 while renewed, unlimited slots, SFTP, mods/plugins and DDoS protection.

name: FreezeHost
limits: 2GB RAM, 2 vCPU and 10GB NVMe by default; earned coins can raise it to 12GB RAM, 3.5 vCPU and 30GB. Smart hibernation when empty; no queue.
notes: No card. SFTP, mods/plugins, backups and DDoS protection. Upgrade resources with earned coins.

name: MCServerHost
limits: 4GB RAM, 10GB NVMe and no slot cap. Servers auto-sleep when empty and auto-start on join; the free plan is ad-supported.
notes: No card. Full SFTP, mods/plugins, backups and DDoS protection. Good for occasional play, not 24/7.

name: DracoByte
limits: 4GB RAM, 1 core and 10GB NVMe. Free servers stay online while active but sleep after 7 days with no players; joining wakes them. Sleeping servers are not deleted.
notes: No card. 1,500+ servers, mods/plugins and DDoS protection. Not for communities that stay empty for a week.

name: Seedloaf
limits: 4GB RAM, 6GB NVMe, 200% CPU and 20 slots. Sleeps when empty; ad-supported and no card is required.
notes: Modpacks, Bedrock crossplay, backups and DDoS protection. Canada/North America nodes.

name: Host2Play
limits: 3GB RAM, 3 cores and 2GB disk. Free servers require renewal and do not stay online 24/7; 24/7 availability is a paid add-on.
notes: No card. Five regions, mods/plugins and backups. The disk is small, so keep worlds lean.

name: IceHost
limits: 4GB RAM, 1.5 cores and 5GB NVMe. Renew daily; each renewal adds 6h and can be extended repeatedly. Servers sleep and get a 3-day grace period.
notes: No card. Mods/plugins, SFTP and backups. Polish provider with a small free plan.

name: Gaming4Free
limits: 2GB RAM, 5GB SSD and 100 Java slots (30 Bedrock). The free lease starts at 3h; watching ads adds time up to 24h, then the server must be renewed. Worlds are kept 60 days after expiry.
notes: No card. Java/Bedrock, mods/plugins, SFTP and backups. Ad-supported extension model, not true 24/7.

name: AcoreZero
limits: 6GB RAM, 3 vCores, 10GB NVMe and 3 ports. Renew every 20h; the server may auto-sleep when the node is loaded and is deleted after 7 days without renewal.
notes: No card. Mods/plugins, SFTP and backups. Official specs differ from directory listings, so verify resources in the panel.

name: FreeMcHosting
limits: 4GB RAM and 10GB disk on the documented free plan; the panel can show different resources. Earn credits (5 start plus up to 15/day) and renew; a 4GB/10GB server costs about 3.8 credits/day. No uptime guarantee.
notes: Nonprofit and no card. Java/Bedrock, SFTP, mods/plugins and DDoS protection. Panel is at client.freemchosting.com.
